decisions.reason: A cleaning soap is a cheap accessory that complements the core flooring offer, and with only one year of evidence its value is still uncertain, so the option is worth more than its low carrying cost.
Maintenance oil fits the firm's oiled-floor range at minimal carrying cost, and nothing yet shows its value will fail to materialise.
The care product for oiled floors overlaps somewhat with the soap and oil, but the cost of keeping it listed is low and its uncertainty has not resolved, so keeping the option is justified.
A moisture-protection underlay is a low-cost system accessory that supports flooring sales, so it is worth keeping while demand becomes clear.
The high-density underlay foam may compete with the moisture-protection underlay, but its carrying cost is small and the evidence after one year is too thin to show its value won't be realised.
The oak parquet sits at the heart of the firm's core business, and early market presence gives no sign that its value is failing.
